feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 19 November 2026 11:30am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Thursday, 19 November 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Often cloudy with only the risk of isolated showers or very occasional rain this afternoon and evening. The risk of rain diminishes as clear skies develop early tonight. Moderate to fresh easterly winds, locally strong at first. Maximum temperatures of 9°C.

Comments: Strong wind at first.

Clear skies and light to moderate northeast winds for the latter half of Thursday night, providing a chilly start to the day on Friday. Minimum temperatures of around 0°C in some spots, bringing a grass frost, and a risk of ice.

Dry and sunny during the daytime on Friday, with light to moderate northeast winds becoming light and variable as the day progresses. Maximum temperature 8°C.

Temperatures will fall quickly after sunset to around -1°C in central areas, bringing the risk of frost and ice.

Comments: Risk of ice and frost at first and again later.


##Outlook##

Clear spells overnight into Saturday giving another chilly start to the day with frost in places and a risk of ice. Minimum temperature of -1°C in some spots.

Dry with sunny spells during the daytime on Saturday. Light easterly winds will gradually strengthen, becoming a strong southeasterly by the evening. Top temperature 8°C.

Comments: Frost and a risk of ice in places at first. Strong winds later.


##Sunrise##

7:55am Tomorrow


##Sunset##

4:12pm Tomorrow
